public_summary: PrismML's ternary Bonsai 2 27B packs a 27B-class hybrid-attention model into 5.95 GB (PTQ1_0, 1.75 bpw) and requires PrismML's llama.cpp fork. On an RTX 5070 it decodes at ~59 tok/s fully GPU-resident and validates useful context at 32K, but fails frozen reliability gates under its default xhigh thinking (budget exhaustion, not fabrication) - NOT_READY on this reasoning-on profile. A paired study against a practical Qwen3.8-27B reference finds near-parity on 48 mechanically-scored tasks with a narrow fluent-fabrication tail; the same artifact also runs on an 8 GB RTX 2060 SUPER at 8K context (19.9 tok/s decode). Configuration is part of the result: the separately profiled thinking-off configuration classifies READY_WITH_GUARDRAILS in the follow-up event.
